D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the annual carnival is from
April 11­13, 2025; a new Jiu­Jitsu class will be introduced in mid­April; and reported that he attended the
“88 for 28” meeting, for the Los Angeles County’s 88 cities in preparation for the 2028 Olympic Games.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that the Public Safety Junior Fair will be held on March
28, 2025, at Furgeson Elementary School.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

There were no Oral Council Reports.

H. CLOSED SESSION

1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957
  Title: City Attorney

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, read the Closed Session Item into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 7:13 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 7:48 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:49 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, April 9, 2025 at 6:00 PM.
